content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make farina, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sift the farina to remove lumps (2 minutes)
Step 2. Measure out the cold water (30 seconds)
Step 3. Slowly whisk the grains into the boiling liquid (3 minutes)
Step 4. Adjust the heat to a low simmer (15 seconds)
Step 5. Cover the pot with a tight-fitting lid (10 seconds)
Step 6. Set the breakfast table (5 minutes)
Step 7. Take the farina container out of the pantry (20 seconds)
Step 8. Rinse the measuring cup (30 seconds)
Step 9. Bring the water to a gentle boil (5 minutes)
Step 10. Add a pinch of sea salt (10 seconds)
Step 11. Stir in a splash of whole milk for creaminess (1 minute)
Step 12. Let the mixture thicken slightly (4 minutes)
Step 13. Check the consistency of the cereal (30 seconds)
Step 14. Place the dirty spoons in the dishwasher (1 minute)
Step 15. Whisk vigorously to ensure no clumping (2 minutes)
Step 16. Find a clean medium-sized saucepan (45 seconds)
Step 17. Ladle the hot farina into serving bowls (2 minutes)
Step 18. Pour the measured water into the saucepan (15 seconds)
Step 19. Add a teaspoon of honey (20 seconds)
Step 20. Sprinkle a pinch of cinnamon on top (15 seconds)
Step 21. Place the saucepan on the stovetop burner (10 seconds)
Step 22. Select the best quality wheat farina (1 minute)
Step 23. Warm the milk in the microwave (1 minute)
Step 24. Inspect the farina for any impurities (1 minute)
Step 25. Add a pat of butter to each bowl (15 seconds)
Step 26. Gather the toppings from the cupboard (2 minutes)
Step 27. Clean the countertop area (3 minutes)
Step 28. Wipe any spills from the water measuring (30 seconds)
Step 29. Allow the farina to sit for a moment (2 minutes)
Step 30. Discard the farina packaging (30 seconds)
Step 31. Fetch the sugar bowl (45 seconds)
Step 32. Wash your hands thoroughly (40 seconds)
Step 33. Stir the farina one last time (30 seconds)
Step 34. Get the serving tray ready (1 minute)
Step 35. Prepare the garnishes like fresh berries (4 minutes)
Step 36. Clear a space on the stove (1 minute)
Step 37. Taste the mixture for sweetness (15 seconds)
Step 38. Turn on the kitchen exhaust fan (10 seconds)
Step 39. Dry the mixing bowl (1 minute)
Step 40. Retrieve a wooden spoon (15 seconds)
Step 41. Put the farina box back in the pantry (30 seconds)
Step 42. Monitor the texture as it cooks (5 minutes)
Step 43. Turn off the stovetop burner (5 seconds)
Step 44. Add a handful of raisins (20 seconds)
Step 45. Wipe the edges of the serving bowls (45 seconds)
Step 46. Pour a glass of orange juice (1 minute)
Step 47. Slice a banana for the topping (1 minute)
Step 48. Open the drawer to get a spoon (10 seconds)
Step 49. Lay out a cloth napkin (15 seconds)
Step 50. Toast a slice of bread on the side (3 minutes)
Step 51. Peel the banana (20 seconds)
Step 52. Check the expiration date on the farina (15 seconds)
Step 53. Arrange the banana slices on the cereal (1 minute)
Step 54. Remove the lid to check progress (10 seconds)
Step 55. Locate the whisk in the utensil bin (20 seconds)
Step 56. Butter the toast (45 seconds)
Step 57. Set a kitchen timer for the simmer (10 seconds)
Step 58. Rinse the fresh berries (2 minutes)
Step 59. Move the pot to a cool burner (10 seconds)
Step 60. Serve the farina while hot (1 minute)
